_doc: Differences between arm A (15.0.8) and arm B (15.0.9 candidate) that 15.0.9 makes on purpose. Each entry: a regex over the analyser's signature, why, and where the change is promised (a section of releases/cgm-remote-monitor-15.0.9/release-notes.md, or another decision record when the release notes do not cover it; those are listed with release_notes_gap=true). Ignored in an A/A run, where every difference is a finding. Add an entry only with the section that promises the change.

thresholds._doc: leak: one arm's heap-minima slope minus the other's, times the evaluated span (the last 75% of the longest process lifetime), must exceed leak_growth_mb. Calibrated 2026-09-25: a 25-min A/A control of 15.0.8 against itself differed by 3.1 MB; the same run with arm b retaining 16 KB per request differed by 80 MB. rss_growth_mb is the same test on RSS minima; RSS is noisier (allocator and GC release timing), so its margin is wider.

allow_5xx.label: ^loop\.remote\.
allow_5xx.why: POST /api/v2/notifications/loop answers 500 when no Apple push key (LOOP_APNS_*) is configured; the lab has none, so both arms answer 500
